title: restart_adb
description: Ask the bench to restart its local adb server, then answer with adb_list (src/alb/remote/protocol.py:215-225; clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:5210-5236). Fire-and-forget; benches that predate this verb ignore it.

kill_conflicts.description: Also terminate processes the bench itself judges to be foreign adb builds. The hub never names a process.
